subject.title: ci: stress race detection with a GOMAXPROCS sweep and repeat count

question: Should the GOMAXPROCS 2/8, count-5 race sweep run on every push and pull request, or on a scheduled/manual stress cadence?
rationale: Both designs are technically valid, but repository policy and acceptable recurring CI minutes cannot be inferred from the patch or one successful run.

options.title: Split fast and stress CI
options.body: Keep the current single race pass as the required gate and move the repeated GOMAXPROCS sweep to schedule or workflow_dispatch.

options.title: Accept the routine multiplier
options.body: Merge as proposed and explicitly accept four matrix jobs and ten race-test iterations per operating system on every run.

options.title: Reduce the stress level
options.body: Use one additional parallelism value or a smaller repeat count to trade some coverage for lower routine cost.

recommendation.title: Split fast and stress CI
recommendation.body: Keep the current single race pass as the required gate and move the repeated GOMAXPROCS sweep to schedule or workflow_dispatch.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available repository-level owner for choosing the CI coverage and cost policy.
